thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic monitor alerting spike detected: 7 distinct monitors tripped in the last 3m in eu-west-1. Suppressing duplicate pages for 10m. Incident ID: INC-20260315-01

Sam G.: saw the bot. getting paged repeatedly — looks noisy: many monitors firing with the same error (HTTP 502 from the inference gateway).

Irina V.: link to quickstack? https://dash.redwood.io/d/synth/summary?org=redwood&from=now-30m :eyes:

Sam G.: logs show transient 502s from edge -> runtime, timing cluster at ~20s. Not all customers affected. Probably an upstream GC/scale blip.

Alex P.: I can confirm failures align with a spike of short-lived model-restarts on a subset of hosts. Restart logs: `oom-kill -> model reload -> warmup`. Frequency ~1/hr per host.

Maria K.: Paging noise is killer atm. Can we quiet the dedupe window and reduce pages for the next 30m while we triage?

Sam G.: I'm muting the high-frequency synth alerts for eu-west-1 for 20m (temp). Will add a manual note in incident.

oncall-bot: Alert policy change applied by Sam G.: muted synth-critical-eu-west for 20m.

Julian T.: +1 on muting. But we should avoid masking real customer impact. Any telemetry showing increased user-facing errors?

Alex P.: Customer errors are flat in our API gateway 1xx-5xx summary. A handful of retries have higher latency but error rate on prod routes <0.2% above baseline. Not a broad outage.

Sam G.: So action plan: 1) suppress noisy synth pages 2) adjust probe frequency & thresholds to reduce false-positive noise 3) implement short-term dedupe/escalation tweaks 4) create a dashboard that surfaces restart-rate per host and correlated latency.

Irina V.: I'll take ownership of the dashboard and the long-term probe tuning follow-up. Quick notes for the team: the current synth monitors are uniform across regions and don't account for host restart noise. We should bucket by host group and use rate-based thresholds (errors per 5m) instead of single-sample failures.

Sam G.: For immediate mitigation I propose these quick changes:
- reduce probe frequency from 30s -> 120s for non-critical synthetics in eu-west-1
- change alert trigger to failures >= 3 in 5m (instead of any failure)
- add a suppression: do not page if host_restart_rate > 1 in 10m (we can derive from infra metric)

Alex P.: I'll push a short config patch to the synth repo. Patch preview: 
```yaml
- id: synth-llm-latency-eu-west
  freq: 120s
  window: 5m
  failure_threshold: 3
  dedupe: 10m
  tag_filters: [region:eu-west-1, type:synthetic]
```
Do we want to apply to all synthetics or only the low-severity ones?

Maria K.: Only non-sev1 probes. Keep the customer-impact monitors (login, checkout, api-gen) at current sampling. We need to avoid blind spots.

Sam G.: Agreed. I'll document which probe IDs are exempt.

Irina V.: For medium-term: we should resample probes into buckets by expected baseline: low-latency vs long-tail (few-shot longer contexts). Then set adaptive thresholds per bucket. That drastically reduces FP when a specific host class has model warmups.

Julian T.: Also add a small splay/randomization to probe schedule to reduce correlated hammering. 120s fixed can cause synchronized collisions. Use `jitter: +-20%`.

Sam G.: Good call. I'll add jitter and host-bucket thresholds.

Alex P.: Pushing the patch now to `main` with a feature-flagged rollout. Command: `./deploy-synth-config --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --flag=probe-quieter-20260315`

deploy-bot: Build succeeded for synth-config (sha: ab12cd). Rolling feature-flag to 25% of synth nodes in eu-west-1.

Maria K.: While that rolls, I'm creating an alert-suppression rule at the paging layer to avoid re-paging for the same monitor group for 10m and to auto-close synthetic incidents if affected customers < 0.5% and no error spike in API gateway.

Irina V.: Dashboard plan (Irin a):
- restart-rate per host (1m and 10m windows)
- synth-failure-rate by probe ID and host-bucket
- customer-facing error-rate for the same time slices
- correlated latency heatmap (edge -> runtime -> model)
I'll reuse the existing dashboard `synth/ops` and add new panels.

Sam G.: Quick runbook note for handoff:
- What happened: host-side model restarts caused transient 502s. Synthetic monitors firing matched these restarts.
- Mitigation applied: reduced non-critical probe frequency, changed trigger to 3 fails/5m, added 10m dedupe, temporarily muted pages for eu-west-1 low-severity synthetics.
- Customer impact: isolated to a small subset (estimated <0.5% of active tokens); no broad user-visible failures. Some higher tail latencies for a few tenants, retries masked some failures.
- Next steps: Irina to own dashboard + follow-up action item to implement bucketed/adaptive thresholds and probe jitter. Alex to validate host restart correlation and propose kernel/oom fixes to infra. Maria to draft alerting SLA exceptions and update paging policy.

Julian T.: I'll follow up with infra on the host restart signals — might be container OOM or preemptible eviction pattern.

Alex P.: Confirming rollout completed to 25% and telemetry shows synth alert count down by ~70% in the rolled group. No increase in customer error-rate.

deploy-bot: Feature-flag rollout: 25% -> 100% scheduled in 6m if metrics stable.

Sam G.: I'll hand off to Irina for the next 8 hours. Leaving a short checklist in the channel: monitor synth-alert-rate, watch api-gateway 5xx, watch host restart-rate. If customer error-rate increases >0.5% open a P0 and revert probe changes.

Irina V.: Taking on-call. Summary received. I'll keep the muting window and the feature-flag watch. Will also add a pinned message with the dashboard link and the short runbook.

Maria K.: Thanks team. Filing follow-up tickets:
- SRE-3452: Adaptive probe buckets + thresholds (owner: Irina)
- SRE-3453: Probe schedule jitter and splay (owner: Alex)
- SRE-3454: Page suppression rules and SLA exception doc (owner: Maria)
- INFRA-4321: Investigate host restart causes (owner: Julian)

Sam G.: closing live thread — will update incident log with timeline and config diffs. If anything new pops, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 transitioned to MONITORED state. Notes written by Sam G.

Irina V.: (handoff note) I'll include a brief postmortem if the restarts persist. For now monitoring and ticket backlog created.

Sam G.: thanks all, nice quick coordinated run.

Julian T.: Good triage. One last FYI: infra has a scheduled kernel patch next week that might affect memory reclaim — I'll correlate once applied.

Maria K.: ack. I'll also update the on-call playbook with the new `failure_count_in_window` rule examples and a small snippet you can copy: 
```yaml
alert: synth-failure-count
expr: sum by (probe_id) (increase(synth_failures_total[5m])) >= 3
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/synth-noise
```

Irina V.: pinned runbook + dashboard link added. Handoff complete.

Sam G.: thread closed.
